Does the East well have cleaner water than the West well?\n\nWater that is deeper in the ground is cleaner because that water has to move through more underground soil.The East well will have the cleaner water than the West well. This East well is 50ft deeper than the West well.

Does water evaporate quicker in oceans or rivers?\n\nWater will evaporate quicker from the ocean than from rivers. Oceans have over 650 times more surface area than rivers. This greater amount of surface area allows for more evaporation to occur in the ocean.

Where does the water in the pool come from?\n\nWater that fills the pool below the condenser comes from the air. The air temperature decreased by 20 degrees. The colder air from the condenser causes the water molecules in the air to slow down enough for them to attract each other and form liquid water.
Is the water polluted?\n\nThe sensors detect water pollution at 200 parts per million. We cannot see the water pollution because it is dissolved in the water. The water is polluted.

What happens to salt when it is added to a glass of water?\n\nWhen salt is added to a glass of water the salt is not destroyed. The mass of the water was 80 grams, the mass of the salt was 20g, and the total mass of the saltwater was 100g. After combining the water and salt, the salt dissolved into the water and the number of molecules was the same because the total mass was the sum of the combined salt and water.

What is ice?\n\nWhen liquid water is cooled the molecules slow down causing ice to form. The temperature of water is 25 degrees celsius, the temperature of ice is 0 degrees celsius. Ice is frozen water.

What is steam?\n\nThe temperature of steam is 100 degrees celsius, and the temperature of liquid water is 25 degrees celsius. When liquid water is heated the molecules move faster turing the water into steam. Steam is gaseous water.

What happens to the molecules of a match when the match is burned?\n\nWhen burning a match the molecules that make up the match are not destroyed. The mass of the unburned match is 2 grams, the mass of the burned match is 1.75 grams. When burning the match some of the molecules that make up the match are turned into smoke or gas that can no longer be measured.

What determines how fast a ball can travel?\n\nOne ball has a mass of 10 grams another ball has a mass of 15 grams, and both balls were thrown with the same force. Since the heavier ball is made of more molecules it requires more force to move. The mass of a ball can determine how fast it travels.
